svg.title: Component refactor cadence
svg.desc: Component replays before and after the shared-renderer refactor, using the same optimized engine. Each workload uses a separate zero-based absolute scale, with endpoints printed below its marks. Whiskers show recorded minimum and maximum, not confidence intervals. Menu opening: previous median 60.003 FPS, range 60.0015 to 60.004; current median 60.0025 FPS, range 60.0025 to 60.0045. Navbar drag: previous median 60.003 FPS, range 60.001 to 60.004; current median 60.0025 FPS, range 60 to 60.003. Segmented control drag: previous median 60.0025 FPS, range 60.0015 to 60.003; current median 60.0025 FPS, range 60.0015 to 60.003. 2026-11-14 · 5 trials/build · DPR 2. Before db71502 · after d57e933 · near 60 Hz
